scripts.docker:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile seed run --rm seed
scripts.docker:seed:prod: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production --profile seed run --rm seed
scripts.docker:lab:provision: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f deploy/lab-tr069/docker-compose.lab.yml --profile lab-provision run --rm lab-provision
scripts.docker:lab:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f deploy/lab-tr069/docker-compose.lab.yml up -d lab-mongo lab-vpnacs lab-genieacs
scripts.docker:lab:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f deploy/lab-tr069/docker-compose.lab.yml stop lab-mongo lab-vpnacs lab-genieacs lab-ovpn-client 2>/dev/null; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f deploy/lab-tr069/docker-compose.lab.yml rm -f lab-mongo lab-vpnacs lab-genieacs lab-ovpn-client 2>/dev/null; true
